title: Chapter 53
text:
Friends who pay $20,000 for 500 bullets and $400 for one bullet, tell me who your math teacher is and I'll burn some incense for him.

— —

"Ding Ling Ling —"

The ear-piercing fire alarm sounded. Thick black smoke rose from the R&D department and a raging fire broke out. The members of the R&D department hurriedly evacuated.

The automatic sprinklers on the ceiling sprayed water and the fire was quickly extinguished. All that was left was a mess. All kinds of documents and blueprints were wet and turned into soft mud. Some of the computers that were not waterproof crashed and emitted sparks. The walls and floor were charred black.

"Why did it suddenly catch fire?" The head of the R&D department looked at the mess with a lingering fear.

The guards quickly arrived and checked the scene.

"The fire came from the workshop!"

Luo Xuan was drenched and wrapped in a blanket. He was brought out by the guards. His face was charred black and his hair was burned clean. Even his eyebrows were gone. He looked like a bald braised egg. Ah, no, it was a preserved egg.

Luo Xuan was scared. If he hadn't dodged quickly and had a fire extinguisher next to him, he would have been disfigured.

He didn't expect that the combustion agent for the high-explosive ammunition was actually gas. Once the bullet was opened, it would leak out and burn immediately when it came into contact with the outside world. It was as if it couldn't be opened after it was made. Even in a vacuum environment, it could still burn temporarily.

With his technology, it was impossible to replicate it.

I lost … Luo Xuan was unwilling.

"What did you do?!" The head of the R&D department said angrily.

The guard took out a few black bullet shells. He could vaguely make out the red background. "These are high-explosive ammunition shells. Your people were researching high-explosive ammunition."

The head of the R&D department opened his eyes wide and pointed at Luo Xuan speechlessly.

Do you think my orders are nonsense?!

If the higher-ups investigate, I'll be the scapegoat again!

You're all sinners!

Gu Hui came quickly and said sternly, "Explain it to me."

The head of the R&D department gritted his teeth and dragged Luo Xuan in front of him. "It's all his own decision!"

Gu Hui was expressionless. "Do you have anything to say?"

Luo Xuan lowered his head. If his secret research was successful, it would be a great achievement. However, he was exposed. He disobeyed orders and even caused a fire in the headquarters. He was just an ordinary member with no background.

"I remember that you are a member of the Logistics Department. Transfer back," Gu Hui said and turned to leave.

Luo Xuan's body trembled. He had jumped ship and left the logistics department, and now he was transferred back. This was a form of suppression.

He returned to the logistics department with a black face (in various senses). When his former colleagues saw Luo Xuan, they all turned their heads and pretended not to see him. It was completely different from how they used to fawn over him. The head of the logistics department, who had once thought highly of him, was not even willing to see him. He only sent a secretary to inform Luo Xuan that he would be working in a small team in the future.

Luo Xuan instantly felt a sense of loss, and he couldn't help but wonder if he had made the wrong choice.

If he hadn't been so arrogant and narrow-minded back then, he wouldn't have lost his mind and these things wouldn't have happened.

I'm still too young … Luo Xuan felt depressed.

…

When Han Xiao heard about Luo Xuan from Feng Jun, he was immediately shocked. Even he, the creator, didn't dare to open the high-explosive bullet after it was formed. That guy was really awesome.

What a ferocious bunch. I'm impressed.

Very soon, Han Xiao threw this matter to the back of his mind. His impression of Luo Xuan was still only a name.

Zhang Wei's Combatant Armor was sent to his workshop. The technology of the prototype was very rough.

[War Armor (Prototype)]

Type: Small Full Cover Single Soldier Armor

Quality: White

Basic Attributes: 682/1,400 Armor, 35 Defense, 86 Power Level, 250/250 Energy

Requirements: 42 STR, 48 END

Bonus Attribute: -10 DEX

Height: 1.95m

Weight: 370lb

Control Method: Human Control (No Microchip)

Energy Source: Electricity

Battle Consumption: 5 Energy/min

Core Power Output: 125/130 Ona

Skeleton Module: Spring-piston Shock Absorber. Reduces weight by 65%. Slightly increases shock resistance. Power Usage: 20

Left Arm Module: Large Caliber Triple-Barreled Machine Gun (as above)

Right Arm Module: Pop-Up Alloy Blade. Attack: 12-15, Power Level: 9, Power Usage: 5

Legs Module: Spring-powered Running Device. + 15 Movement Speed: 1 Energy/min. Power Usage: 30

Accessory Module: Simple Thermal Imaging Device (No Power Usage)

Accessory Module: Hexagonal Heavy Steel Shield (No Power Usage)

Accessory Ability: Thick Armor. Reduces physical damage by 12%

Remarks: This is a disgrace to the world of armor!

Simple!

Han Xiao almost could not bear to look at it.

First of all, not to mention the low power output, there was not even a microchip installed. The microchip was the core of the mech. It was used to load various battle programs to assist the user in battle. Without a microchip, there was no way to quickly collect and process information on the battlefield. Without a wide area detection method, one could only rely on the naked eye to find the enemy. Furthermore, one's vision was limited by the helmet. How could this be played? No wonder Zhang Wei used strafing instead of point shooting. There was no way to aim!

Speaking of power, only the legs were mechanically powered. There was not even an endoskeleton installed. The rest of the body was completely dependent on the user. He finally understood why Zhang Wei did not use the steel shield on his back. F * ck, it could not be used!

Furthermore, the outer armor was so crude that he could not bear to look at it directly. A few pieces of metal were simply welded together to form the armor. It showed the crudeness of Theseus everywhere.

Even if this thing is a prototype, you still have to treat it seriously, you bastard!

Han Xiao's mouth twitched as he sized up the Warrior Armor. He crossed his arms in front of his chest and tapped his arms rhythmically with his fingers. All sorts of ideas gradually appeared in his mind.

However, there was no rush to modify it. Some ideas still needed to be learned and understood. Han Xiao hastily repaired it and asked Feng Jun to return it to Zhang Wei.

Now, he had to consider another matter. The three Germinal Organization bases had been destroyed. What information should he give to Stardragon next?

The three bases were just the tip of the iceberg of the Germinal Organization. There were no other Germinal Organization bases in Stardragon. Han Xiao then gave the location, and Stardragon's troops had to leave the country to fight. The armed forces trespassing into another country's territory was openly starting a war. Although the Six Nations were secretly competing against each other, no one wanted to start a war at this time. The war between the old era and the new era had greatly depleted the national strength. The Six Nations were all recuperating and recovering from the wounds of the war. Whether or not they would fight in the future was still unknown.

Therefore, cross-border battles required cooperation with other countries, which would increase the number of variables. Just relying on his intelligence was not enough. He had to go with the team to deal with any unexpected situations.

The problem was whether the Stardragon higher-ups would reject his request to leave the Western Capital.

Feng Jun suddenly called. His tone was serious.

"Han Xiao, the Germinal Organization's spies in the Western Capital have begun to move. They seem to know that you are working for us."

"I know."

Han Xiao was very calm. When Li Yalin used the Lightweight Mechanical Arm, he had already expected this situation.

"Don't worry, we have a large number of people in the vicinity to monitor you 24/7."

The Western Capital was Division 13's territory. Even if the Germinal Organization found his location, they would have to pay a high price to deal with him.

However, he still had to be careful. Han Xiao knew that the Germinal Organization had some super assassins that were very difficult to deal with.

He should prepare some weapons for self-defense.

"Help me get two Berserk Eagle pistols from your department's warehouse."

The Berserk Eagle was a handgun for close range combat. It was known for its large caliber. Within 30 meters, its power was comparable to that of a sniper rifle. Beyond that, however, its power decreased rapidly.

The combination of a high-powered pistol and [Slide Shot] could be considered as both offensive and defensive.

Other than the pistols, he also needed to make close range weapons.

In the past three days, he had earned nearly 100,000 experience points from making high-explosive bullets. Without hesitation, Han Xiao spent 40,000 experience points to upgrade [Elementary Refining] to level 5, meeting the requirements for making platinum alloy.

He needed to upgrade his equipment.

…

A few days ago, when the leader found out that Zero's lightweight mechanical arm had appeared on a Stardragon agent and connected the dots to the three military attacks on Stardragon's bases, he could only conclude that Zero had joined Stardragon and leaked information about the Germinal Organization.

"Is this a supernatural incident?"

The leader could not understand. Zero had never come into contact with such information. How did he know the location of the secret base? He had not suspected Zero at all. He had thought that there was a mole and had almost killed one of the higher-ups.

Zero's arrogant words from a month ago appeared in his mind. "I will destroy you all!"

Is this what you're relying on?

The leader clenched his fists, his eyes frightening. "I underestimated you, but you're not qualified to be our enemy! I don't believe that you have so much confidential information! "

"Pass down my order. Recruit some new faces and rogues. Send them to Stardragon to investigate Zero's whereabouts. As long as they find anything, the organization will reward them handsomely!"

The leader's voice was cold and murderous.

"If they find anything, let Norsa deal with him."

Norsa was the same rank as Hella. He was an executive officer of the Germinal Organization, an assassin.

Every executive officer had their own strengths. The number of executives in the Germinal Organization had always been a secret. Even their own people did not know.

The leader's eyes were deep.

You think you can do whatever you want just because you joined Stardragon?

How naive!
